video.agency.evidence: [地狱领主·codex] 图1第2行第8格至第4行第2格（3.75–6.25秒），我长时间保持举剑向上的姿势，敌人已贴身，护盾逐渐成形后仍未及时转入连续劈砍。站在我的立场，此时应立即攻击身边目标；这些格子未体现规格2.7–10.4秒要求的约每0.8秒一剑，存在举剑停等。；[树人·claude] Speaking as the treant: 0–1.0s (row 1, cells 1–5), all three of us charge at him from the left, right and front, which is correct. From 1.25–3.75s (end of row 1 through row 2), the three of us crowd and pile onto the horse and rider instead of staying apart at his left, right and front. The cells don't clearly show the spec's 1.6–2.1s beat, where all three branch arms swing down at him together. After the shield forms at 4.25s, from 4.5–9.5s (row 3, cell 3 through row 5, cell 7), the two front treants are pressed against the front of the sphere, overlapping the membrane and largely in front of it. Their postures barely change from cell to cell. I can't make out a strike every ~0.7s, any bounce-off with a ripple, or the flinch, stagger and lunge back after each sword hit. 6.5s, 8.0s and 8.75s show a bright blue hit flash, but the treant that was hit has no visible flinch. This reads like standing in place, which matches 'treants standing still' and 'treants only lightly touching the shield' from the negative list. I can't tell whether they are actually striking continuously, so this fails.

From 10.25s on they are being blown backward and falling, which is exempt. I can't confirm their gaze stays on him throughout, so this fails.

video.readability.evidence: [audience·claude] Judging only from the contact sheet, a first-time viewer can tell the story. 0.0–1.5s: a white-haired swordsman on horseback stands on a muddy battlefield, surrounded by several root/tree monsters. 1.75–3.75s: the monsters close in and swarm him. 3.75–4.25s: he raises his sword overhead and a glowing sword appears above him. From 4.25s a transparent dome spreads out from around him and covers him and the nearby monsters, and 5.0–6.25s adds rotating rings of light, so it is clearly him casting the skill. 6.5–9.5s: blue light points flare up on several monsters inside the dome, and at 6.5 and 8.5s there are slashes of light near the sword, so the monsters are the ones being hit. 9.75–10.0s: the dome bursts with intense blue light on every monster. 10.25–10.75s: the monsters are blown into the air and broken apart, with debris flying. 11.0–11.25s: their bodies fall into the mud. 11.5–13.75s: only the swordsman is left on horseback among the wreckage, so the result is clearly shown. Who cast it (the swordsman), what it was (a light-dome area skill), who it hit (the surrounding monsters) and the result (all monsters destroyed) can all be described. Minor issues that don't change the verdict: 1.75–3.75s and 6.75–9.5s, the swordsman is largely blocked by monsters and hard to see. 10.0–10.5s, the swordsman briefly can't be seen at all. 6.5–9.5s, the blue light points on the monsters have no clear beam linking them to the sword, so how the hits land is a little vague.
